notes.title: What's Coming in the Next Major Update ?
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello Survivors![/h1][/b]
It's been a while since we last updated you about the development of [b]Rooted[/b], so it’s time to catch up!

These past months have brought exciting news for [b]Headlight Studio[/b]. We’ll soon share more details about the big steps we've taken to continue on our mission from the start: remaining fully independent! [b]Headlight Studio[/b] is moving forward thanks to you, so a huge thank you!

Now, let's talk about [b]Rooted [/b]and the next major update that will officially kick off [b]Phase 3 of the Alpha[/b]. Discover now the [url=https://portal.productboard.com/rooted/2-rooted-alpha/tabs/10--alpha-3-0-in-development-]main features of Phase 3 on our Productboard[/url].

[b][h1]Starting Zone: Lore and Gameplay
[/h1][/b]
[b]Phase 3[/b] will represent the true beginning of the player experience as we originally envisioned. This area introduces each survivor to the lore, immersing you psychologically into this post-apocalyptic adventure.

Here, you'll discover who you are and unravel your story, key aspects for a deep immersion. This zone is also where you'll make your first discoveries regarding gameplay elements, from basic interactions to initial experiences with hunting, fishing, weapon handling, combat, and much more. I’d love to spoil the setting and story, but I’ll limit myself to sharing a few blockout screenshots, so you can enjoy discovering everything yourself when the update goes live!

[h1][b]Communication Tower
[/b][/h1]

The Communication Tower plays a central role in the lore of [b]Rooted[/b]. Present since the very first Alpha build, you'll finally experience it as initially imagined. Majestic yet ravaged, bearing witness to past battles, violence, and a time when humanity lost itself to the fear of death, the Comm Tower will become a landmark.

Remember the days when you built scaffolding around it with unlimited resources? (This is not a challenge!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/e7037e1e3876eacaad7c2fe1e00385e12d8410e3.jpg[/img]
 
[b][h1]Survival Gameplay
[/h1][/b]
The environment evolves, and so does gameplay! With hunting, fishing, gardening, and all the related gameplay, the survival experience really takes shape. Food management becomes crucial and diverse. You'll have to juggle various methods of obtaining food, influencing where you decide to set up your base.

New tools will make your life easier. Remember, the game takes place around the year 2100... Remnants of past civilization that you find during expeditions will start becoming useful in your everyday survival!

[h1][b]Firearms (and Early Phase 4)
[/b][/h1]

Although combat was originally scheduled for Phase 4, it arrives earlier in a lighter form tied to hunting. This phase introduces your first firearms, helping you survive encounters with animals looking to turn you into dinner. Or the other way around, for you to prepare substantial meals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/c48d556c35fbd4165b2520f7b98ea1276b83e619.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Character Rework
[/b][/h1]

You've frequently mentioned on social media that character animations weren't our strongest suit. While motion capture allowed us to level up in this unfamiliar domain, we've listened to your feedback and are making adjustments to enhance your gaming experience.

We're also now using [b]Mutable[/b], a cutting-edge technology for character customization, perfectly suited for our ambitions.

[h1][b]Have You Named Your Drone Companion Yet?
[/b][/h1]

For a few months, you've had a small drone attached to your backpack, never leaving its spot until now. You know where I’m going with this, right? :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/3f8682e62b2d5fd5ef425df8a6336e77387386df.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Beware of Severe Weather Conditions
[/b][/h1]

I can’t reveal more, otherwise, that would be too much of a spoiler. Sorry!

[h1][b]Optimizing the Open World
[/b][/h1]

This is a huge topic, and we're committed to delivering an experience worthy of [b]Rooted[/b]. Leveraging [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b] technologies, we're doing everything possible to ensure smoother gameplay. While we can't promise incredible framerates yet, you’ll notice significant improvements in Phase 3.

[h1][b]UI Overhaul
[/b][/h1]

We admit, we haven't focused much on the UI through Phase 2.

That's because many elements were evolving rapidly, and UI wasn't our main priority in the early Alpha stages. Although UI isn't becoming our top priority now either, we’re leveraging recent experience to improve it and make your gameplay more enjoyable.

[h1][b]When Will It Be Released?
[/b][/h1]

This question comes up frequently, and we love that! You're eager to play, and we're eager to see you play! Many of the new elements and improvements I’ve mentioned are interconnected, making it challenging to release updates piecemeal as we've done previously.

Expect releases throughout this year. We've fallen a bit behind our initial timeline because we've been working extremely hard in the first half of the year to maintain our independence. And we've succeeded! But that's another story, because what matters here and now is [b]Rooted[/b]! (Spoiler: Headlight Studio just reached an exciting new milestone!)

[h1][b]A Huge Thank You!
[/b][/h1]

Massive thanks to everyone who continues supporting us daily, pledging to the game, and trusting us. You're amazing! Even though we've been quieter on social media lately - totally focused on development - you remain incredibly active and supportive. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! <3

notes.title: Exciting Updates on Rooted – Alpha 2 is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

We’re thrilled to share some exciting updates about [b]Rooted[/b]! Thanks to your incredible support, the game has evolved significantly, and we’re proud to announce that [b]Alpha 2[/b] is now live!

[h2]What’s New in Alpha 2?[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Sh7MIIC234c;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*][b]Expanded Open World:[/b] The playable area now spans over 30km², featuring new Points of Interest such as the Mansion, Monastery, Gas Station, Bunker and more.
[*][b]New Gameplay Features:[/b] Enjoy crafting, infection mechanics, and a dynamic weather system that enriches the survival experience.
[*][b]Coming Soon in Phase 3:[/b] We’ve already started working on new additions like hunting, fishing, and gardening, as well as refining existing systems.
[/list]
We deeply appreciate your unwavering support, which has been vital in bringing these updates to fruition. We look forward to continuing this incredible journey alongside you!

[h2]Join the Alpha or Wishlist the Game[/h2]
Haven’t joined the Alpha yet? There’s no better time to experience the evolution of [b]Rooted[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Play the Alpha:[/b] Visit our Official Website
[*][b]And Wishlist on Steam[/b] 
[/list]

Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. Stay tuned for more updates, and feel free to share your feedback or questions with us.

Warm regards,  
[b]Mat[/b]

notes.title: Rooted Alpha Phase 2 Preview: open world, Building, Drones, and More!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Although we haven’t officially launched the second phase of our Alpha, we’re excited to share all the new features available for our alpha testers.

[previewyoutube=M13vHRb5CwM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Open World[/h2]

A large portion of the Open World is now accessible, featuring over a dozen points of interest. Some are in near-final form, while others are still in blockout, but all showcase our progress.

[h2]Building and Resource Gathering[/h2]

With our latest Alpha build, players can now gather resources and construct their first cabins, houses, or bases, depending on their ambition! We’re actively developing the building and crafting systems, and we’ll be adding new features in the coming weeks.

[h2]Drones[/h2]

Players can now find drones scattered across the world. These allow for faster exploration of certain areas and enable players to place a marker on a location spotted from the sky, making it easier to find from the ground.

[h2]Infection and Gas Masks[/h2]

The bacteria responsible for the apocalypse is becoming more present in the world. An antidote – or even better, a respirator mask – will allow you to explore some contaminated areas with reduced risk.

[h2]Swimming
[/h2]
As an introduction to fishing activities planned for Alpha Phase 3, swimming has been added and is now accessible across the map. In the near future, more lakes and rivers will also be available.

[h2]Vehicles[/h2]

Although vehicles are planned as mid-game gameplay elements, we’ve started introducing them to Rooted. Besides the Alpha Car, a special vehicle for alpha testers to explore faster if desired, we’ve added, for example, a forklift that enables players to access hard-to-reach areas.

We’ll be releasing a devlog when we officially launch Alpha Phase 2, but we hope you enjoyed this sneak peek 🙂

Thank you very much for your support and interest in Rooted ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Open World Technical Overview
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

As we approach the launch of Phase 2 of the Rooted alpha, we're excited to kick off this series of posts on our website to share our development journey, including the technical and artistic challenges we face. In summary, these posts will give you a glimpse into our daily life as developers, working on what excites us all: Rooted!

In this first post, I'll discuss managing the Open World.
[h2]Map Opening[/h2]
[b]Phase 2 of the Alpha allows us to include a large portion of the map in the build[/b]. Following a first Alpha session that was limited in scope (only the Monastery was available), you will now have the opportunity to explore and test the building system in a significantly larger area. Use this Alpha period to scout for the best spots for your future bases, but be cautious... there's no guarantee that a point of interest won't appear later, in the lead-up to Early Access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/3ad13c67410241ec7dc09dc046388886eee7e0e1.gif[/img]

[h2]Open World: Challenges and Technological Choices[/h2]
    Opting for an Open World for Rooted was a significant decision that comes with major challenges, necessitating critical technological choices.

[h3] World Partition and Server Streaming[/h3]
Choosing Unreal Engine 5 plays a major role, especially due to the World Partition technology, which segments the map into a grid. All zones are loaded and unloaded dynamically based on players' locations, easing the load on players' PCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/78e49204705392eab24b3ed10356b41d5003ab30.gif[/img]

Implemented in Alpha 2, the tests are promising except for one issue: in the current version of Unreal Engine, the World Partition does not support Server Streaming. This means that the player hosting the game must load the entire map to manage player collisions in different cells.

With Unreal Engine 5.4 expected soon (announced at GDC 2024), Server Streaming will allow the server to load only the zones where players are located. We've tested this with a build version of the engine where we enabled Server Streaming, and the results are promising. [b]We are eagerly awaiting UE 5.4 for our Alpha 2.0.[/b]

[h3]Developing Our Technology[/h3]
To avoid being overly dependent on updates to Unreal Engine 5, we are collaborating with [url=https://twitter.com/phyronnaz]Victor Careil[/url], developer of the successful Voxel Plugin for Unreal. This collaboration has led to a technology that manages the loading and display of all map environment props based on a Pool system.

In real time, a Pool of actors is updated to display all props near the player. These props include items like tables, chairs, pens, glasses, and PCs. [b]For context, over 16,000 actors are involved in just the Monastery alone, amounting to several hundred thousand in the final game, displayed by only a few thousand actors making up our Pool.[/b] Essentially, this is a contingent of actors that we move around, dynamically assigning them appearances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/fff05a82119a4534b19b9a3028e24668f93f7e9b.gif[/img]

A major advantage of this solution is that it also functions in editor mode while we work on our map. In areas with a high density of props, this saves precious time and greatly enhances our comfort and efficiency in development.

[h2] Landscape and Vegetation Generation with PCG (Procedural Content Generation)[/h2]
[h3]Landscape[/h3]
Although our game is not a solo narrative type, we have created a Lore that allows us to forge a coherent environment, which we consider essential for offering a high-quality post-apocalyptic setting and atmosphere.

For this reason, [b]we have naturally created our Landscape and then sculpt it in-engine to add layers from past civilizations, their stories, with buildings and road infrastructures.[/b]

For the Material Landscape, we use the RVT (runtime virtual texture), which provides natural transitions between the landscape and environment assets such as rocks, trees, and roads.
[h3]Foliage[/h3]
    However, [b]procedural generation helps us create a rich world[/b]. This was already the case at the Monastery with our generator for walls, floors, and vaults, which, even on a small scale, allows for realistic results. For vegetation in Rooted, we use two technologies:
[list]    [*]        [b]PCG[/b], which allows us to develop our own procedural logic to generate a consistent environment based on various factors (masks, terrain inclination, altitude, etc.). The size/age of trees, their density, and absence on roads are all meticulously managed through procedural generation.    [/*]    [*]        [b]Grass Node[/b], relating to foliage types such as grass, tall grasses, and ferns, communicates with our Landscape layers. Depending on what we define in the shader, specific types of plants and grasses are added to the environment.    [/*][/list]    

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/65ba2ba1cfd6b20a55eb4f087e11ab8df52c2ae3.jpg[/img]

    I'll discuss how we manage the harvesting/farming of natural resources in a dedicated post.

[h2]Rendering Optimization[/h2]
I mentioned challenges at the beginning of this post, and here is a significant one. We are developing Rooted to run on the average PC that will appear in Steam's statistics in a couple of years, with the goal of pushing technical limits further without reinventing what already exists. [b]However, we are aware that many people are eager to participate in the alpha, and for this reason, we are making significant efforts to improve performance now[/b].

Alpha 1 was very instructive in this regard. It's never simple with a major first title like Rooted, developed on a recent engine with new technologies and thus with limited feedback from other developers, to definitively validate all our workflow choices. And that's precisely why we decided to launch an alpha very early—to avoid realizing too late that some choices we had made were not the right ones.

Following this incredible initial testing period, we have revisited several points.
[h3]Materials[/h3]
[b]Our basic idea is simple: create and reuse as many generic materials (metal, wood, concrete) as possible[/b] to minimize the number of textures needed to avoid overloading your PCs. A low number of textures also allows us to opt for a higher initial resolution, thus achieving a truly beautiful rendering.

This is what we did at the Monastery: using instances of this material, with Material Layers we created to add layers of dirt, moss, and other imperfections. Think of Material Layers as effect layers in Photoshop. Unfortunately, this choice rests on the incompatibility of Vertex Painting on meshes using Nanite. Vertex Painting allows for painting instances of meshes present in the world, adding elements like moss or dirt, as we mentioned in an [url=https://x.com/RootedTheGame/status/1576970677738819592]old tweet[/url]. 

The feedback from the Alpha has been excellent in this respect, but from a performance standpoint, it's not feasible to rely solely on this workflow. The reason: the number of material instances the game must load at runtime to display all objects.                    
From a technical standpoint, Nanite performs a drawcall per different material, and the more materials there are, the more resource-intensive it is to generate a frame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/c3b11763a3acfeb2d7f492800e8cfcceceac98c0.jpg[/img]

With the aim of reducing the number of drawcalls, we have begun to enrich our materials workflow by adding "real generic materials" and using trimsheets. [b]Thus, a single simplified material with few instructions covers much more assets. The result is just as clean, with a substantial savings in drawcalls.[/b]
[h3]WPO, Triplanar[/h3]
Among other technical points we have worked on, I can mention:
[list]    [*]        [b]World Position Offset[/b]: allows for movement of all vegetation based on wind or collision with a character. While the visual rendering is interesting and essential, it is nonetheless resource-intensive. We now control this element in Alpha 2, preventing movement on meshes too far from the character.    [/*]    [*]        [b]Custom Triplanar[/b]: projects the texture into the world, especially on modular assets, to maintain visual coherence at the junctions, ensuring continuity of material rendering. There are no visible seams between walls. Its major disadvantage is its cost in resources. We have created for Rooted an optimized Triplanar, using only one texture sampling (versus three with the classical Triplanar), with specific UV calculations in the shader. Thanks to this, we have an optimized Triplanar that allows for a very nice visual rendering with a very low impact on performance.    [/*][/list]
    Here are some of the points we wanted to share with you. If you're interested in this type of post, and would like even more detail on the technical aspects, don't hesitate to let us know on social media!

    See you soon and thank you again for your support!

    Mat

notes.title: Alpha: 'Rooted's' Time Loop Event Takes Players 20 Years Back!
notes.content:
[h2]Rooted Halloween Special Event[/h2]

The Halloween season offers a chance to see the Monastery in a new light... and by night! Dive into the lore of Rooted, taking you back 20 years when everything changed, leading to humanity's disappearance. We are seizing this event to introduce new features.

[h2]The Halloween Event - ROOTED Alpha Session[/h2]

[b]Event Dates: [/b]From October 28, 01:00 am CEST to November 10, 2023, 11:59 pm CEST.

[b]Event Purpose: [/b] Owing to the Halloween event, play between life and death with a high enough infection rate to see traces of a ghost guiding you to the most notable and useful places, and discover the ghostly scenes of the past. Make proper use of all remnants from the past, including the injectors and... pumpkins! They will greatly assist you!

[b]Exclusive Halloween items: it's now or never![/b] We have specially created Halloween items for the occasion that you will find in-game in chests you'll need to discover. Only one chest per game session, and everyone can loot it if you're playing with others. No pressure! 

[u][b]The items obtained are permanently tied to your account.[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/250dd742b27d219434d44c44a9694a5c781aa416.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/f56e4fb61d864b29baa1ea4039f2270e39055490.jpg[/img]

[h2]Game Update Features[/h2]

[h3]The emote system[/h3]
Interact with players using the new emote pie menu. Enjoy the initial emotes! Not all of them will stay, and new ones will be arriving soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/58e0d1106aaaeecfae7dee0d69793f8462ab2ba0.png[/img]

[h3]The infection[/h3]
Tackle the deadly bacterium from two decades ago. Plants spread this infection, and other players can infect you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/4174f15020aa6afe1ec53ae4505479c4ae22f3c3.png[/img]

[h3]The health system[/h3]
Monitor your health closely. Eat and drink to stay fit, and keep your infection rate in check!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/d341fc587dc9b824cd616339950ea9a0a0646556.png[/img]

[h3]The equipment system[/h3]
Gear up with items from the Rooted world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/1cc07d1f33b2e158a91ed63ecec80b50479fd5f9.png[/img]

We've also addressed many bugs from your reports. Please continue reporting any issues through our in-game system. Your feedback is invaluable!

[h2]Halloween Special Items Information[/h2]

[b]Availability: [/b]These items are up for grabs only during the event, ending on November 10th. Miss out now, and you'll miss out forever!

[b]Permanence & Exclusivity: [/b]Once secured, these items are yours through every stage of the game. However, they are non-transferable.

[b]Looting Mechanism: [/b]One chest per session, lootable by all, ensures every player gets a unique item. 

[h2]Alpha Invitations Details[/h2]

[b]Limitations:[/b] One Alpha invite per player. Not all will get one.
[b]Redemption Process: [/b]Scored an invite? Head to our website, log in, go to 'Rewards', and send the invite to a friend.
[b]Scope: [/b]This invite is for the Alpha only. It excludes other game stages and pledge rewards.

We continue the game development steadily, and no, don't expect an event for Christmas! While some new items will most likely be added to your collection, we need to focus on the game's development :)

[b]Happy Halloween to everyone![/b]

Mat

notes.title: Everything you need to know before launching the first alpha
notes.content:
Hi Survivors!    
    The alpha is fast approaching, and we are in the process of finalizing preparations for its launch this Monday, September 4th.

    Here are some key pieces of information you should know:
[h2]    Key to Access the Alpha (Steam Playtest version of the game)[/h2][list]    [*]        [b]You are Founders (Lone Wolf and above)[/b]        
        The key granting you access to the Alpha of Rooted will be communicated to you between September 2nd and 3rd, 2023, via your Rootedthegame.com account and by email. Remember to check your spam folder, or simply log in to the Rooted website!    [/*]    [*]        [b]You are registered on the website to participate in the alpha[/b]        
        Invitations will be sent by email throughout the duration of the alpha. If you haven’t received a game key in the coming days, don't worry! You may have a chance to receive it a bit later. No need to register again.    [/*]    [*]        [b]Important Information[/b]        
        Several people have asked us on Discord if we plan to let you pre-download the game to be ready right at the alpha launch. Know that we are truly thrilled by your enthusiasm, but we are only in the first alpha. We're saving marketing techniques for the early access launch!    [/*][/list]
    For now, we're focused on development, and there's a good chance the build you'll be able to download was compiled just a few minutes before :)
[h2]    Alpha Launch Date[/h2]
    We are planning to launch on[b] September 4th at 2:00 PM CEST[/b]. 
[h2]    Alpha 1.0 Content[/h2]
    As announced for several months now, this first phase comes early in the game's development. It has several objectives:
[list]    [*]        To thank all the founders who support Rooted by allowing them to set foot in the World of Tomorrow as soon as the alpha goes online.    [/*]    [*]        To obtain initial feedback from players, whether it’s feedback, bugs, or technical information exchanges,    [/*]    [*]        To continue developing Rooted transparently, as we've been doing since the beginning, to build this amazing post-apocalyptic survival experience together.    [/*][/list]
    [b]In this first alpha, you'll be able to control the character for the first time, discover the entire Monastery area, (listen to your PC's fans), play with the initial puzzle game elements, explore dark or hard-to-reach areas...[/b]    
    And day by day, week after week, [b]we will be releasing fixes and updates for content and features.[/b]

    As a reminder, the Alpha will be split in four major phases, each featuring numerous patch updates and new feature additions. Learn more here: [url=https://portal.productboard.com/rooted/2-rooted-alpha]https://portal.productboard.com/rooted/2-rooted-alpha[/url]
[h2]    Co-op Mode Available[/h2]
    [b]Craft your own adventure or connect with friends to discover the Monastery area together. Joining existing games is also a great way to make new friends![/b]    
    Features are limited for now (VOIP, chat, friendly fire enabled by default to test your friendships...), and they will be quickly improved and supplemented by others.
[h2]    Duration of Alpha 1.0[/h2]
    This first alpha phase may last several weeks, or even months. We will correct bugs reported by players, optimize the game, add new features, and improve existing ones based on player feedback.

    [b]Don't hesitate to log back in regularly to discover new content![/b]
[h2]Gameplay Time for This First Session[/h2]
    It's hard to quantify this, as our internal tests have produced very different results depending on the players.    
    What I can tell you is that the alpha isn’t just about walking around. Open your eyes, explore, and analyze! Discovering the remnants of past civilization is not necessarily an easy task.
[h2]Where to Follow the Alpha News, Access Patch Notes...?[/h2]
    To stay updated on the alpha, find us:
[list]    [*]        on [url=https://discord.com/invite/rootedthegame]Discord[/url]    [/*]    [*]        on the [url=https://rootedthegame.com/news]News page[/url] of the Website    [/*]    [*]        on [url=https://twitter.com/RootedTheGame]Twitter[/url]    [/*][/list][h2]    Content Under NDA[/h2]
    Since day one, we’ve been transparent about our progress, sharing numerous things on social media and our Discord server. [b]So why an NDA asking all testers not to share anything about the Alpha?[/b]

    [b]Rooted is receiving strong enthusiasm from players, and we simply don't want the alpha to be presented as the final game. In terms of gameplay, environment, user interface, and many other points, there is still much to do. Sharing on social media would not serve much purpose at this stage.[/b]

    For content creators,[url=https://www.dropbox.com/sh/si9su7kpg4rfa3a/AACLQd_QuyEIEa9mBmG9TSh_a?dl=0] we will share numerous screenshots and videos in our Media folder[/url] that will allow you to talk about Rooted and the Alpha launch, the Monastery, but we rely on your discretion not to talk about what we do not show :) Thanks from the entire team!

    [b]Let's move forward together using the tools provided to build a great Rooted experience, and you'll have the entire future to share content about the game during early access.[/b]

    [b]The NDA will be available at the game's launch. You will be required to review and accept the NDA, as well as link your Rootedthegame.com account to the game (by providing the email address used on the website), in order to gain access to the Alpha.[/b]
[h2]    Report Bugs[/h2]
    We have added[b] an in-game bug reporting system[/b] so you can easily inform us about the issues you encounter while playing. We instantly receive the tickets, and we make every effort to publish fixes quickly. You can directly check the status of bug reports in the game.

    Even though we have created dedicated channels for the alpha on Discord, no bug reports will be considered there. [b]For organizational reasons, please use exclusively the in-game reporting system for any issues.[/b]
[h2]    Want to Interact with All Other Alpha Participants?[/h2]
    [b]Our Discord server has private channels dedicated to the Alpha. To access them, it’s simple and automated:[/b]
[list]    [*]        Join our Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/rootedthegame]https://discord.com/invite/rootedthegame[/url]    [/*]    [*]        Log in at [url=https://rootedthegame.com/login]https://rootedthegame.com/login[/url]    [/*]    [*]        Update your Discord ID on the profile page: [url=https://rootedthegame.com/account/profile]https://rootedthegame.com/account/profile[/url]    [/*]    [*]        Our bot automatically assigns you the correct roles, granting you access to the private channels if you have access to the Alpha.    [/*][/list][h2]    What Hardware is Needed to Play the Alpha[/h2]
    The alpha will allow us to receive lots of feedback on performance, and we will optimize rendering accordingly.

    [b]Rooted is a "next-gen" oriented game developed with Unreal Engine 5 and uses many of the new features of the engine, for which newer PCs will naturally have better performance.[/b]    
    However, we will take into account your feedback and make the necessary adjustments so that the experience is as enjoyable as possible even on older hardware.    
    [b]Feel free to play with the graphical settings to achieve better performance.[/b]

    The latest technologies like DLSS 3 with Frame Generation are also available. If you are the proud owner of a Nvidia 4000 series, don't hesitate to activate it!
[h2]    An Alpha with Respect for All[/h2]
    Our entire team is ready and excited to face the influx of feedback from you, while continuing to fully work on the game to roll out updates. We know it's customary to compare indie productions with AAA studios, but no, we are just a few enthusiasts dedicating all our time to the development of Rooted! Please consider this when giving your feedback.

    Thank you again for your support!

    The Rooted Team

notes.content:
[h2]Get a chance to be part of the Alpha of ROOTED!
Register now 👉 [url=https://rootedthegame.com]https://rootedthegame.com[/url][/h2]

While the creation of ROOTED continues at a very good pace with new POIs (have a look at the end of this post) that we will present soon on our Discord server, I am pleased to announce new features on our website! 
[b]Register to be part of the Alpha, Pledge the game, update your pledge, get your Steam Keys for Early Access and your Roles on Discord, + upcoming features!
[/b]
[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] if you have already pledge on Kickstarter or on the website during the last weeks, you already have an account. Just ask a new password here: https://rootedthegame.com/forgot-password

[b]I can't leave you without sharing an example of a POI blockout we worked on: the Monastery.[/b] Of course, we will let you discover the catacombs and all its surprises in game!

notes.title: Our Road Map and PVP news
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for your support! While the community has until October 21th to continue to support us,[b] the Kickstarter goal is reached![/b] We are happy to announce that all the backers will have a special outfit!

[b]Now, let's talk about our Roadmap and PVP.[/b]

[h2]Strech goals become our Roadmap[/h2]
Thanks to the all backers, players and medias which brought us visibility, with the kickstarter and other ways to get funds, we now have the possibility to go further, thank you so much for that! Strech goals are now our Roadmap.

[b]Here is the Roadmap.[/b] You may notice something at the bottom, regarding PVP in Rooted... 
I'm gonna share some information about it below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129180/05501086025ee66788bd33f544f7a3ec7c498869.jpg[/img]

[h2]PVP in Rooted: some news![/h2]
Since many of you ask for PVP in Rooted, we have decided first to add an option to enable Friendly Fire. Then day after day, while we were working on the game, we realized that [b]we could add a more suitable version of our map for a PVP mode[/b], with the possibility of being hosted on dedicated servers. [b]The community with a preference for PVP will then be able to have fun in a 100% pvp game mode,[/b] with more than just a few players.

[b]IMPORTANT: Our development remains focused on the PVE / Co-op part because it is this experience that we absolutely want to deliver. This is the DNA of ROOTED. Friendly fire will still be available in the PVE / Co-op mode.[/b]

Have a nice day!

Mat

notes.title: Some news from Rooted!
notes.content:
Survivors!

This week has been crazy for us after sharing the first videos featuring one of the Rooted characters. Here is more information about our game.

[h2]ROOTED, a Post Apocalyptic survival[/h2]

We love it. Post apocalyptic makes us experience incredible emotions in games, and we couldn't imagine another theme for Rooted. The Last Uf Us, Scum, DayZ and other titles that are real sources of inspiration for us.
If the typical gameplay mechanics of survival games are well present in Rooted, new ways of moving, of management that evolve with your experience in the game are implemented.  We hope you will like it!

[h2]Play single or multiplayer[/h2]
Rooted offers you to evolve both in single and multiplayer. Your friends can join you and evolve with you. You will be able to share your camp, your resources, explore together, and use the game mechanics created by your allies.

We want to offer you a rich experience in both single and multiplayer.

[h2]The game is in its early stages of creation[/h2]
We are currently working mainly on the gameplay mechanics, and we have decided to share with you some videos showing some of our features, in a post-apocalyptic environment, in order to better project you in the final experience.

And in this first phase, the focus is on the 3Cs. We want players to have fun controlling the characters and evolving in the open world! Using the Unreal Engine 5 technologies, we start from solid foundations and implement our ideas, our mechanics... In short, we create the feeling we want.

The backpack physics scene allows us to emphasize the interaction with the backpack, which allows us to attach inventory items such as tools, weapons, or various items you find in dilapidated buildings and want to keep for customizing your bag! Customization is at the heart of the game.

We implement a day and night cycle. One of our videos shows you the real time rendering, which is really amazing. We love the lighting, we love the night, we love transitions, we love!  We hope you love too.

In developing the character constants, which are affected by many factors including altitude, weather..., we shared a weather transition (quick for the video), to show the details we care about, like making the character cross his arms when he's cold. We love immersion. 

[h2]Follow us on our networks so you don't miss the next videos[/h2]
https://linktr.ee/rootedthegame

[h2]Rooted, on PC and consoles?[/h2]
At this stage of development, we are focused on the PC version of the game, and you can add it to your wishlist right now.
We would love to share the Rooted experience on consoles. We'll come back to this point much later in the progress of our project.

[h2]To support Rooted[/h2]
If you would like to support Rooted, there is only one thing to do: tell your friends and wishlist about Rooted! Thank you for your support!

We will continue to share with you the development of it, to share with you the fun we have in creating it. Thank you to all the players who enjoy our project, and support us. 

We can't wait for you to play it!

[b]See you soon![/b]
